jobs.description: Visit us at the Trade Fair Aalsmeer - 3, 4 and 5 November - stand 2.5  OZ Hami English  - Working at -  Operations Support Officer  De Kwakel  32-40 hour  HBO  On location Are you at the start of your career and do you want to work in a dynamic environment where you can learn a lot about logistics and processes? Then this is the perfect opportunity for you! About OZ-Hami What could be better than working with the most beautiful flowers in the world? At OZ-Hami, one of the largest flower exporters in the Netherlands, we get to enjoy this every day. OZ-Hami is the parent company of the traditional Dutch family businesses OZ Export and Hamifleurs, which together have more than 100 years of experience in the international flower trade. Our motto is "To Flower the World", and with customers in more than 60 countries, we proudly stand behind it. Our flowers find their way to the flower market in Milan, royal palaces in the Middle East, players at football clubs such as Liverpool and the Formula 1 Grand Prix. And you are part of this! We love sharing our passion for flowers with everyone: from colleagues to growers. Together you achieve more than alone. Together we form a strong team in which everyone can flourish. OZ-Hami is part of Dutch Flower Group, one of the largest digital flower trading houses in the world. What you will do In the role of Operations Support Officer, you are an important link in our logistics process within the Operations Support department. You help make sure everything runs smoothly, from inbound to loading, and actively contribute to improvement projects. After an extensive onboarding programme, your work as an Operations Support Officer looks like this: - Guiding: you support the logistics process of inbound, order picking, processing and loading; - Monitoring: you keep an eye on process quality and make corrections where necessary, so that targets are met. A label of houseofwork.nl  Orchid Worker Do you enjoy working with plants and seeing them grow? As an Orchid Worker, you help care for orchids and prepare them for customers. Your work may include potting, supporting, sorting and packing plants. Bring your motivation and careful approach to this full-time role.  Company Through House of Work, you will work at a company that grows orchids. You and your colleagues care for plants in the greenhouse and prepare them for customers. Careful handling helps keep the plants in good condition.  Job information In this full-time role, you help care for orchids and prepare them for delivery. Your tasks depend on the work available and may include potting, supporting, sorting and packing plants. Your main tasks include: - Available tasks include placing support stakes and attaching clips. - Pot orchids, sort plants and pack products. - Help care for, grow and prepare orchids.  Requirements  - You enjoy working with flowers and plants. - You are motivated and flexible in your work. - Greenhouse experience is an advantage. - You speak English. Dutch is an advantage. - A driving licence is an advantage. - You have your own housing.  Offer  - A salary in line with the market, starting from €14.99 gross per hour, excluding allowances. - Weekly salary payment. - Possibilities for transport to and from work. - Support from a job coach who is your regular point of contact. Would you like to join the team? We look forward to your application. Click the apply button to apply. Bike Mechanic - Amsterdam (Warehouse) Job Description  What you will do Ready to join Team Warehouse and to keep our blue wheels turning? At Swapfiets , we're on a mission to make biking the easy, sustainable choice for everyone. We keep our members on the go by providing a high-quality ride including free check-ups and repairs. Joining us means becoming part of this purposeful mission, and working alongside a great team in a fast-paced, fun environment to make it happen! As a bike mechanic at Swapfiets you are an essential part of the growth and continuity of Swapfiets. In this role you will repair all of our original and e-bikes without supervision. You are the expert in making sure our bikes are roadworthy and safe. Besides that, you will also make sure we deliver the Swapfiets quality day in, day out. How you pedal us forward! - You will be responsible for repairing our pedal bikes and our E-bikes with no supervision needed; - You will repair E-Bikes and pedal bikes and make them roadworthy; - You will ensure the Bikes' product and repair data is properly captured and up to date in repair database; - You will be handling special case repairs (in use, double frame numbers, founds, missings, special brokens that require documentation for insurance/police); - You will organize broken inflow and pre-organizing of the bikes (Triage); - We will make sure that you learn how to work in a safe way (safety is everyone's responsibility). The gear you need! - You have elementary knowledge about e-bikes and pedal bikes (cars or anything related can also be of help); - You have an affinity with cycling, mobility, sustainability and service; - Understand and speak English and/or Dutch; - Whether working independently or as part of a team, you always work successfully!; Benefits for a smooth ride! - Your own Swapfiets (lease); - A salary of €2795 per month - Fixed working hours/days possible. Then co-driver, is the perfect stepping stone for you! As a co-driver at bidfood in Utrecht, you will head out daily with the truck driver to various restaurants and canteens. Together, you drive a Bidfood truck through your region and deliver orders to our customers. You always work with a driver, and together you make it a fun ride.  what we offer  Gross hourly wage of € 15,20  Working the early/day shift  Opportunities for advancement within the company!  Travel allowance of € 0,23 per km  Free freshly prepared lunch and dinner  € 5,04 coffee money per day  who you are As a co-driver you meet the following requirements: - You speak good Dutch and/or English. - You are physically fit and have demonstrable experience with physically demanding work (for example, in construction, logistics, or removals). - You hold a B driving license and are willing to obtain a C driving license. - You are available full-time and have no problem working from Monday to Saturday. - You can be on location within 30 minutes using your own transport (e-bike, scooter, car).  what will you do As a co-driver, you are the face of our company. You are on the road all day, but make no mistake: this is not a quiet drive through the countryside. You drive short routes with many stops, constantly getting in and out to unload goods. It is physically demanding work where lifting and hauling are the order of the day. - At the end of the day, you return the truck to Bidfood in Utrecht and hand over the reports to your team leader. - Together with the driver, you load the truck with products for our customers...
